reasoning: 驗證車速自 <= V_Car_Moving 上升至 > V_Car_Moving 時，TLM 經 ServiceMode_Popup_Trigger.Info 送出版面請求並顯示對應 popup。關鍵情境為車速跨越門檻之邊界。V_Car_Moving = 4 km/h、容差 0.5 km/h 取自規格常數表（段 1662），故取 4 與 4.0625 兩點（後者為 DBC 解析度 0.0625 km/h 之最小上跨）。規格另述 Ignition Off→On 之或分支，其 ignition 訊號規格未給實名，依 §8.4.1 不臆造，列 §K 並由本條之 Remarks 揭露未涵蓋。內部訊號 ServiceMode_Popup_Trigger.Info 段 1 未解，該步 PENDING。

test_procedure: Read the signal $STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig$ and check that it is 64
Read the named UI element "Step on the brake pedal" pop-up and check that it is displayed
expected_result: The signal $STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig$ = 64 is registered without a bus error
The signal $STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig$ = 65 is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Step on the brake pedal" pop-up is displayed
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.test_item:
When the TLM receives a value changing from <= [V_Car_Moving] to > [V_Car_Moving] via signals (STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig), Then TLM shall send a layout request to the display manager through internal signal (ServiceMode_Popup_Trigger.Info)
(Boundary crossing of V_Car_Moving raises the brake-pedal popup)

distinguishing_axis.delta: 車速 raw 64 (= V_Car_Moving 4 km/h) 與 65 (> 門檻)，為門檻上跨之最小步進

tcs.remarks: V_Car_Moving = 4 km/h per the spec constant table; raw 64 = 4 km/h and raw 65 = 4.0625 km/h at the DBC factor 0.0625 km/h. The ignition Off to On alternative branch is not covered: the spec names no signal for ignition status (see section K). ServiceMode_Popup_Trigger.Info is unresolved at stage 1; observation method requested under DR-VL4
